While he doesn't have the requested 8 years of dedicated AI experience, his strong software engineering fundamentals, cloud experience (AWS), and recent, highly relevant work in the agentic AI space make him a compelling candidate worth exploring further.

Proven Staff-level seniority and extensive experience building production-grade, high-performance backend and data systems.
